post.summary: Create an account. Responds identically whether or not the email is already registered.
Sign in with email and password. Sets the session cookie.
End the current session.

get.summary: The signed-in user, the CSRF token for state-changing requests, and two-factor state.

post.summary: Confirm an email address with the token from the verification email.
Send a new verification email to the signed-in user.
Request a password reset email. Responds identically for every address.
Set a new password with a reset token. Signs the account out everywhere.

get.summary: Two-factor status of the signed-in user.

Confirm setup with a code. Returns backup codes, shown only once.
Complete sign-in with an authenticator code or a backup code.

get.summary: Signed-in devices for the current user.

delete.summary: Sign out one of the current user’s devices.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is running. Does not check dependencies.
Readiness: the API can reach PostgreSQL and Redis.
The signed-in user’s profile.

Change password. Signs out all other devices and renews the current session.

get.summary: List users (Super Admin).

patch.summary: Suspend, deactivate or reactivate a user (Super Admin). Ends their sessions.

get.summary: Active issue categories, parents followed by their children.

patch.summary: Update or deactivate a category (Super Admin).

Reactivate a suspended organization (reason required).
